meta.title: User standards
meta.description: Cross-project user rules (hard constraints, always injected) and memories (soft notes, retrieved on demand), both with global/project scope and gentle save reminders. Manage them in separate tabs under Settings → User standards: “remember X” saves to memory by default; “write to config/rule/from now on/mandatory” saves a rule. The agent detects save intent or repeated corrections in conversation and offers a nudge, with a confirmation step before saving by default.
